# Review, pass 1 — secret-history-200-200 (§200)

Units are numbered U0-U32 in file order.

## Findings refused

- kürgegsed (U18) as -gsen + -d: kept; the published kürgegsed-i glossary itself reads "-gsed (-gsen + -d)".
- ügüle (U8, U21) bare stem rendered "said", not as imperative: kept; the narrative reading is plain and the note flags it.
- "Qan" in `i` for Qān (U10, U16, U18): kept; conventions give Qaγan/Qahan for the long form only, "Father Qan" for Qān ečige.
- ežen(i)-jen glossed "own-lord-(object)" in `l` while ulus(i)-jan has no "(object)": kept; the lord is the object of böšöžü, the people in U1 are the subject of a passive.
- "ögbe = gave (them up)" (U20): left as is; the `n` flags the reading as uncertain. Not changed to a bare "gave" which would be unreadable.
- "iregdežü = being brought" vs the known-form "having been come to" (U8): kept; Ming 被來着 and the note's gloss support "brought"; remains a doubt.
- budun "common folk" (U13): kept as the drafter's flagged guess against Ming 本.
- oγ̇orčaγ, mün, "Mount Tanglu", "Naiman- / luγ̇a" printed apart: all correct against packet and house renderings.
- Title "§200" (single section) and about paragraph otherwise: kept.

## Remaining doubts

1. U27 aγ̇ušigi: location ("in your lungs") vs coordination ("heart and lungs"); same for öre in U26.
2. U29-U32: who is the subject of the long sentence (Jamuqa, "you") and the sense of üküġülžü / ama-γ̇ar alažu / adalidγatuγai are inferred from Ming alone; the drafter's hedging is kept.
3. U23: reading of the "one shaft" sentence (reproach or condition) unsettled.
4. U9/U12: what the bird figures mean; the roles in U12 (first named = seizer) follow word order.
5. U20 ögbe; U8 iregdežü; U13 budun; U10 qaraču boγ̇ol (apposition vs pair).
6. Glosser pass: bolulča-, duradγa-, adalidγa-, qān lemmas changed here must be matched in gloss.json keys' dictionary forms.
